name: Against Malaria Foundation
summary: Insecticide-treated bed nets, distributed in mass campaigns with partner governments. A re-implementation of GiveWell's model. GiveWell models 8 locations; this page shows DRC, the median location by cost-effectiveness. The others are listed below.
